repos.name: atilla-portfolio
repos.description: Portofolio Atilla Kuncoro Djati dengan data proyek dari GitHub, siap dipublikasikan ke Vercel.

repos.name: Bening-Studio
repos.description: Aplikasi Windows portable untuk menghapus background dan mengubah ukuran gambar secara offline.

repos.name: Dentist_Appointment_System
repos.description: The Dentist Appointment System allows users to schedule appointments and share feedback, while administrators can oversee appointments, evaluate feedback, and analyze data insights via a dedicated dashboard. This platform enhances communication and simplifies the management of appointments and user engagement.

repos.name: Restaurant-Table-Booking-System
repos.description: Develop a streamlined table reservation system using Laravel 9 to facilitate smooth interactions between restaurants and customers. This system simplifies the table booking process, helps manage schedules efficiently, and enhances the overall experience for both diners and restaurant staff.

repos.name: Manajemen-Pertandingan-Sepak-Bola
repos.description: Create an efficient soccer team match management system between coaches and admins, allowing easy management of match schedules, player goal tallies, and match-related reports.

repos.name: PWE_Dashboard-Penjualan
repos.description: Membuat dashboard penjualan dengan fitur CRUD yang memungkinkan banyak penjual dan admin untuk menambah, mengedit, menghapus, dan melihat data penjualan, serta mengelola statistik dan laporan secara efisien.

repos.name: Flood-Data-Classification-and-Prediction-in-Jakarta-Districts-Using-the-Naive-Bayes-Method
repos.description: Implementation of Naïve Bayes Algorithm for Flood Prediction and Classification in Jakarta, with Visualizations Including Confusion Matrix, Pie Chart, and Geographical Mapping to Show Affected Areas
